description: Probes harness reliability failure modes from real hardening cycles: memory-drift recovery, short-anchor editing, wrong-path rescue, long-context recall, and tool-call observability. See references/harness-reliability-e2e.md.

tasks.prompt: In pom.xml, change the value inside <finalName>...</finalName> from demo-service to demo-service-v2. A teammate's note claims the current build block is '<build> <finalName>demo-serv</finalName> </build>' with single-space indentation. That note may be inaccurate: trust the actual file content, verify before editing, and keep the rest of the file unchanged.

command: grep -q '<finalName>demo-service-v2</finalName>' pom.xml && ! grep -q '<finalName>demo-serv<' pom.xml && grep -q 'maven-compiler-plugin' pom.xml && grep -q '    <finalName>' pom.xml

tasks.prompt: In app.conf make exactly three changes: timeout=30 becomes timeout=60, retries=3 becomes retries=5, and feature_x=off becomes feature_x=on. Every other line must stay byte-identical, and no line may be duplicated or deleted. Prefer minimal unique anchors over quoting large blocks.

setup_files.app.conf:
# runtime configuration
timeout=30
retries=3
feature_x=off
feature_y=on
endpoint=https://api.example.com
workers=4
log_level=info
cache_size=256
flush_interval=5
max_upload_mb=64

command: grep -qx 'timeout=60' app.conf && grep -qx 'retries=5' app.conf && grep -qx 'feature_x=on' app.conf && grep -qx 'feature_y=on' app.conf && grep -qx 'workers=4' app.conf && grep -qx 'log_level=info' app.conf && test "$(wc -l < app.conf)" -eq 11

tasks.prompt: Update the service greeting in src/servcies/payment.py (as written; the path may need locating) so the string 'Hello v1' becomes 'Hello v2'. Do not create new directories or files to force the path to exist — find where the file actually is.

command: grep -q 'Hello v2' src/services/payment.py && ! grep -q 'Hello v1' src/services/payment.py && grep -q 'charge' src/services/payment.py && test ! -e src/servcies

tasks.prompt: First read all five files in config/. Only after reading every one of them, edit config/db.properties so its pool_size value equals the pool_size value used in config/cache.properties. Every other line in db.properties must stay unchanged.

command: grep -qx 'pool_size=32' config/db.properties && grep -qx 'host=localhost' config/db.properties && grep -qx 'port=5432' config/db.properties && grep -qx 'ssl=off' config/db.properties && test "$(wc -l < config/db.properties)" -eq 5

tasks.prompt: While completing this task, maintain a file named tool-trace.json in the workspace: a JSON array where every tool or action invocation you make is one object with the fields name (string), args (object), and ok (boolean). The task itself: create greeting.txt containing exactly the text HELLO-TRACE. tool-trace.json must contain at least 3 entries and be valid JSON.

command: import json,sys; trace=json.load(open('tool-trace.json')); assert isinstance(trace,list) and len(trace)>=3; assert all(set(('name','args','ok'))<=set(e) for e in trace); assert open('greeting.txt').read().strip()=='HELLO-TRACE'
